subject: ILCE-6400 exact stock 2.00 external recovery boundary

architecture_controls.claim: Different-model updater architecture control only; it does not establish the original alpha6400 selector, receiver, acceptance, write order, terminal verification, or recovery.

evidence.claim: The signed host engine parses and integrity-checks the DAT container, while complete host authenticity behavior remains unresolved.

gates.blocker: Complete host authenticity behavior and its relationship to camera-side acceptance remain unresolved.

evidence.claim: Storage and pass-through transport functions are statically mapped, but no physical protocol exchange was observed.

gates.blocker: No physical exchange or safe recovery transport behavior has been observed.

evidence.claim: The host decodes camera-returned model and version statuses, but the enforcing camera receiver remains unresolved.

gates.blocker: The pre-2.00 camera-side receiver that enforces model, version, authenticity, and writes is unavailable.

evidence.claim: The pre-normal-runtime component that selects the updater system has not been identified.

gates.blocker: A runtime-independent recovery entry and its selector have not been established.

evidence.claim: Boot-time and runtime integrity enforcement for a modified application image remains unresolved.

gates.blocker: The exact boot-time and runtime integrity checks protecting modified application content remain unresolved.

evidence.claim: The camera verifier, signed byte range, trust anchor, and failure mapping remain unlocated.

details.blocker: Camera-side signed ranges, verifier ownership, trust anchor, and rejection behavior are unlocated.

evidence.claim: Invalid-model return statuses are mapped on the host, without the camera-side comparison implementation or safe mismatch behavior.

details.blocker: Only host-decoded invalid-model statuses are known; the enforcing comparison and safe failure path are unknown.

evidence.claim: An invalid-version return status is mapped on the host, without same-version reinstall or downgrade acceptance behavior.

details.blocker: Same-version 2.00 reinstall and downgrade acceptance behavior have not been established.

evidence.claim: The available 2.00 receiver is post-install; the earlier receiver and complete stock restore write scope remain unavailable.

details.blocker: The installing receiver and exact partitions or ranges restored by the stock updater are unavailable.

evidence.claim: The installing receiver and its complete ordered write and commit sequence have not been located.

details.blocker: The complete ordered write, commit, and transition sequence has not been located.

evidence.claim: The updater-mode authenticity verifier and terminal post-write verification behavior remain unresolved.

details.blocker: Updater-mode authenticity checks and terminal verification behavior remain unresolved.

evidence.claim: Host-side status decoding does not establish camera acceptance of an exact same-version reinstall or downgrade.

details.blocker: Exact 2.00 reinstall and downgrade acceptance are not established by host-side status decoding.

evidence.claim: No bounded evidence establishes restart, resume, rollback, or safe terminal behavior after power loss.

details.blocker: Restart, resume, rollback, and safe terminal behavior after interrupted restoration remain unknown.

evidence.claim: The authenticated Windows host engine exposes bounded DAT, transport, state, model-status, and version-status paths, but camera-side reinstall acceptance and entry independence remain unresolved.
The available target 2.00 receiver is post-install; the earlier receiver that installs 2.00 remains unavailable.

candidates.blocker: The camera-side installing receiver, exact same-version acceptance, runtime-independent entry, write scope and order, post-write verification, and power-loss behavior remain unresolved.

evidence.claim: The host path contains a bounded mode-switch and reconnect boundary, but no physical exchange or camera-side updater selector is established.
The pre-normal-runtime component that selects the updater system remains unidentified, so runtime-independent USB entry is unestablished.

candidates.blocker: A camera-side selector, earliest receiving component, runtime independence, complete stock write behavior, and terminal verification remain unestablished.

evidence.claim: A separate service acquisition hypothesis remains unvalidated and read-only; it does not establish an independently booted stock restore path.

candidates.blocker: No independently bootable maintenance entry, stock write authority, complete write scope, or verification path has been established.

conclusion: The exact stock source and several host-side updater boundaries are mapped, but no runtime-independent entry, camera-side signed range, complete write scope or order, post-write verification, reinstall acceptance, or power-loss behavior is established. Recovery remains unvalidated and camera testing is ineligible.
